descriptions.site_detail-page: Fetch the public source lot document for a required canonical REP park ID. The typed MCP tool returns bounded raw source HTML or a preview, without normalized rate or vehicle-limit semantics. Prefer parking_detail for source-normalized parking planning facts.
descriptions.site_calculator-form: Inspect the public calculator page for a required canonical REP park ID. The typed MCP tool returns bounded raw source HTML or a preview; this GET does not compute a fee. Prefer parking_quote with an explicit bay and JST start/end to run the verified source simulation.
descriptions.site_markers: Fetch raw public marker rows for a required explicit Repark map range in C(lat,lon)N(north)W(west)S(south)E(east) notation, with each bound within 2 km of the explicit center (100 m rounding allowance). Returns provider JSON, including raw occupancy codes and charge groups. Prefer parking_nearby for bounded, normalized planning facts and separate fit assessment.
